an4.126:1.3: Idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo mettāsahagatena cetasā . . . pe [125.1] avyāpajjhena pharitvā viharati. Soyad eva
an4.126:1.5: So kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā Suddhāvāsānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ uppajjati.
an4.126:1.6: Ayaṃ kho bhikkhave uppatti asādhāraṇā puthujjanehi. 2.
an4.126:2.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave idh' ekacco puggalo karuṇāsahagatena cetasā . . . pe . . .
an4.126:2.3: upekhāsahagatena cetasā . . . vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena avyāpajjhena pharitvā viharati . . .
an4.126:2.7: Ime kho bhikkhave cattāro puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmin
